title: Audit Readiness Orchestrator: Compliance Milestone Playbook and Tracker
creator: Ava Ramirez
summary: Create a repeatable, cross-functional milestone playbook and tracker that prepares Redwood Private and Dedicated customers for external audits (SOC2/ISO) with emphasis on SSO/SAML cutovers and audit-log evidence collection. The playbook will include gating rules, automated evidence pipelines, owner assignments, and runbook steps for audit windows.
background: Over the last 18 months multiple enterprise prospects requested a clear audit readiness plan tied to product milestones. Current evidence work is manual, distributed across engineering, security, and customer success. This ticket centralizes orchestration: a single source of truth for milestones, what evidence is required, automation status, and cutover acceptance criteria. Targets: SOC2 Type II readiness and ISO27001 scope for Redwood Private customers in Q2 2026.
goals: Define milestone taxonomy (Evidence, Config, Cutover, Validation)
Map owners and SLAs for each evidence bucket (SSO, Audit Logs, Key Management)
Deliver automation checklist for evidence collection with one-click export for auditors
Reduce manual evidence preparation time by 70% for audit windows
Ship dashboard widgets in Console for audit-readiness status per customer/project
milestones: M1: Evidence Inventory and Owners (due 2026-02-28) - owners assigned for SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS, network controls
M2: Evidence Automation MVP (due 2026-03-25) - scripts and pipelines to snapshot audit-log retention, SSO config exports, and system-account inventories
M3: Validation & Playbook Draft (due 2026-04-10) - cross-functional tabletop to validate playbook and gaps
M4: Console Audit-Readiness Widget (due 2026-04-22) - UI showing per-customer gates and missing evidence
M5: Audit Window Rehearsal (due 2026-04-30) - simulate external auditor request and collect artifacts end-to-end
acceptance_criteria: All evidence buckets have assigned owners and documented location (Confluence/Drive)
Automation pipeline can produce an evidence bundle (logs, SSO export, KMS access logs) within 30 minutes
Console widget displays pass/warn/fail states for at least 80% of required gates
Tabletop rehearsal yields no critical unresolved gaps and has a retro with action items assigned
Stakeholder sign-off: Security, Product, Eng, Customer Success
tasks: Inventory required evidence for SOC2/ISO and map to current artifacts
Create standard export formats for SSO/SAML config (SAML metadata, IdP logs) and document parsing rules
Implement evidence-aggregation Lambda and storage path with retention tagging
Add per-customer audit-readiness API endpoints to surface status to Console
Coordinate with Legal/Compliance to confirm scope and non-production evidence handling
Draft runbook steps for on-call and customer success during audit windows
Plan and run two tabletop rehearsals with simulated auditor requests
risks: Incomplete or inconsistent audit logs across Dedicated and Private deployments
SSO/SAML metadata formats vary by customer IdP causing parsing edge cases
Resource constraints in Eng for automation work during peak roadmap delivery
Retention policy differences for on-prem customers requiring custom handling
Delayed sign-off from external auditors or legal clarification on proof scope
